title: Process-creation event for destructive VSS deletion (vssadmin.exe)
event_type: Sysmon Event ID 1 (Process Create) / Defender for Endpoint DeviceProcessEvents

callouts.explanation: Contains the destructive verb 'delete shadows' that DET-45-01 matches on, distinguishing this from benign vssadmin.exe list/create invocations.
cmd.exe is not on the backup-agent allowlist (veeam.backup.service.exe, wbengine.exe), so this event is not excluded by DET-45-01's parent-process filter.
A helpdesk service account invoking a destructive VSS command from an interactive-looking shell chain is inconsistent with that account's normal automated-ticketing baseline.

note: Illustrative and conceptual only, reconstructed from the Detection Test procedure in section 6.1; not a captured screenshot from any real Windows host or product interface.
